samples.question: This picture is a ladder puzzle drawn in gray. There are four long vertical rails. Each short horizontal bar is a rung, and every rung joins exactly two rails that stand next to each other. A green dot sits on top of one rail, and one coloured square sits under each of the four rails: one blue, one orange, one purple and one red. Start at the green dot and move down the rail below it. Whenever you arrive at an end of a rung you must cross that rung to the rail at its other end, and then keep moving down that rail. You may never move upwards and you may never skip a rung you arrive at, so the rungs are taken in top-to-bottom order. Stop when you reach the bottom of a rail. Which coloured square do you stop at? Answer blue, orange, purple, or red.
